sonnet.problem: This story card says 'the stronger females' get the branches and calls Jacob 'PICKY'. That gives away the answer to the next choice card (card 13), which asks which animals did NOT get the branches ('weak'). The baker can read the answer straight off the setup.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The 'a man [doing something]' simile shape is repeated across the lesson: 'like a man walking into his yearly review' (stop 1, card 7), 'That's a man signing his name in PERMANENT MARKER' (stop 1, card 11), 'like a man with a PLAN' (this card), and 'This man sorts sheep the way I line up chocolate chips' (stop 2, card 9). This is the same punchline shape used several times.
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.
